usage: Used as a noun for the activity of colouring, often in kids' art and schoolwork.
Very common with words like 「做」、「功課」、「本」、「圖畫」, for example in the context of colouring worksheets or activity books.
Natural in everyday Hong Kong speech and classroom talk; not a formal literary word.
The word itself is two syllables: tou4 sik1. Keep the tones clear and even.
